items.title: Establishment of the engineering centre
items.text: Russian Railways (RZD) and the Sinara group of companies incorporated the Railway Transport Engineering Centre.
items.imageAlt: Signing of RZD-Sinara joint engineering agreement.

items.title: Domestic high-speed rolling stock programme
items.text: Launch of domestic high-speed train development programme.

items.title: Infrastructure development centre established
items.text: A new infrastructure development track opened; catenary and permanent-way programmes commenced.
items.imageAlt: Catenary systems and permanent-way development projects.

items.title: Forward-looking projects centre established
items.text: A new innovative rolling-stock development track opened. Hydrogen and hybrid locomotive programmes launched.

items.title: ECRT trials at the VNIIZHT Experimental Ring
items.text: Endurance trials began on ECRT-developed permanent-way engineered for an accumulated gross tonnage of 2.5 billion tonnes, on the VNIIZHT Experimental Ring.

items.title: High-speed train technical design completed
items.text: Core technical solutions for the EVS-360 programme were developed.

items.title: ECRT trials on the RZD network
items.text: Field trials began on ECRT-developed permanent-way engineered for an accumulated gross tonnage of 2.5 billion tonnes — on a section of the Krasnoyarsk Railway, an RZD branch.

items.title: Working design completed and high-speed train production started
items.text: Engineering documentation for the EVS-360 programme was completed; carbody fabrication started at the Ural Locomotives plant.

future.title: Russia’s train of the future
future.lead:
High-speed electric rolling stock is being built at the Ural Locomotives plant. The engineering solutions developed by ECRT match world-class benchmarks and, for several subsystems, exceed them.

Commercial service readiness is planned for 2028.
future.videoAria: Night-time animation of a high-speed train in an urban skyline.

flagship.description: We deliver the core technical solutions for Russia’s first high-speed main line: rolling stock, catenary, and rail fastening.
flagship.mapAlt: Infographic of the first high-speed main line route: stations and design-speed segments.

facts.title: Demonstration speed
facts.body: Aerodynamic profile, a domestically produced traction motor, and unique components designed for climates with large temperature swings.

facts.title: Main line length
facts.body: New track on a concrete subgrade and modernisation of sections in Moscow and Saint Petersburg.

facts.title: Moscow ↔ St Petersburg
facts.body: More than 2 hours saved in journey time compared with the Sapsan EMU.

projects.title: Main projects
projects.evsHomeShowcaseDescription: Development of rolling stock for the high-speed main line. ECRT prepares the specification and conceptual, technical, and detailed design documentation; manufacturing takes place at the Ural Locomotives plant (part of the Sinara Transport Machines group).
projects.showcaseContactVsm1Description: The KS-400 catenary subsystem delivers reliable power transfer to train pantographs at speeds up to 400 km/h.
projects.showcaseVsm1TrackDescription: ECRT is developing ballasted-track rail fastenings for the Moscow–Saint Petersburg high-speed main line.
projects.showcaseOperationSupportTitle: Operations support - Sapsan and Lastochka EMUs
showcaseOperationSupportDescriptions: Support for operation of German-built Sapsan high-speed EMUs and ES1 Lastochka regional electric trains.
The project includes engineering support for structural changes to Sapsan and Lastochka trains as part of import substitution and to improve passenger comfort.
